AddLibraryEntryBody.description: Add a saved library entry to a collection (TASK-235, Library-entry-keyed membership).

depth.description: Relative outline depth (0 = top level), normalized from tag levels.

id.description: Anchor id present on the heading element in the stored readable HTML.

source_heading_index.description:
Document-order heading ordinal (pre-dedupe): the positional fallback
when a cached article body predates anchor ids.

word_count.description: Words in this entry's own section; clients derive minutes at 238 WPM.

truncated.description: True when the outline was capped at the entry limit.

provider.description:
Provider string: one of dashscope, elevenlabs, unreal_speech, inworld,
gemini, polly, mock.

DocumentAssetResponse.description:
Document asset metadata plus an API-origin download URL for its bytes (the
reader fetches the readable HTML from this URL; the asset proxy behind it
streams or redirects depending on `asset_serving_mode`).

DocumentReaderResponse.description:
Reader read-model. `library_entry_id`/`saved` distinguish a prepared-but-unsaved document
from a saved Library entry; `readable_ready` tells the client whether the readable asset has
landed (the on-tap render is async, so a freshly opened document polls until ready).

summary.description:
Resolved short summary. Returns the stored AI summary when present,
falling back to `excerpt`. `null` when neither is available.

EmptyTrashResponse.description: Result of emptying the Library trash: how many entries were permanently purged.

library_entry_id.description:
Saved Library membership id (canonical `lib_` `LibraryEntryId`). The reader link is in
`reader_url`; document-keyed capabilities resolve through the document the entry points at.

FeedDeliveryResponse.description:
A Feed delivery row. Exposes `delivery_id`, `source_entry_id`, and a nullable
`document_id` per docs/document-feed-library-architecture.md (API Shape). Display fields
come from the feed source entry, overlaid by the linked document when one exists.

document_type.description: Content family from the linked document, when materialized.

saved.description: True when the linked document has an active Library entry.

IntegrationConnectionConfigDto.description:
Provider-shaped configuration payload. Uses serde's tagged enum so the
generated OpenAPI schema produces a concrete discriminated union instead
of a bare object — mobile/web codegen can model it as a sealed class/union.

oneOf.description:
Catch-all for providers that don't have first-class structured config
on this surface yet (currently Logseq, BrowserExtension). Kept as one
variant so generated mobile/web codegen doesn't ship empty
`LogseqConfig` / `BrowserExtensionConfig` types that can never be
instantiated. When a provider gains structured config, add a dedicated
variant and route to it from `from_domain`.

pending_jobs.description:
Count of queued integration jobs for this connection (sync + export).
Frontend uses this to render a "pending" pill alongside connection status.

available_oauth_providers.description:
Lowercase ids of OAuth providers this instance holds credentials for.
A provider absent here cannot be connected until an administrator
configures it.

triage_state.description: Narrow the counts to one triage state: inbox, later, archive.

LibraryEntryResponse.description:
A saved Library entry joined with its document. Exposes both `library_entry_id` and
`document_id` per docs/document-feed-library-architecture.md (API Shape).

ingest_failure_reason.description:
Why readable-content ingestion terminally failed. Always serialized:
null means the entry is healthy (or still processing); a string is the
renderer's reason and the entry should render as failed.

summary.description:
Resolved short summary. Returns the stored AI summary when present,
falling back to `excerpt`. `null` when neither is available.

LibraryEntryTagsBody.description:
Replace the Library tag set on a saved entry. Tag names are normalized server-side
(trimmed, lowercased); unknown names create tags.

item_type.description: One of: article, book, email, pdf, tweet, video, podcast.

LibraryQueryBody.description:
Ad-hoc library query: the same filter-expression vocabulary as smart lists
(item_type/triage_state/domain/tags/...), evaluated without persisting a list.
A null/omitted expression returns the unfiltered library.

LibraryScopeCountsResponse.description:
Read-state and item-type breakdown of one library scope. Item types with no saved entries
are omitted, so the list is never a fixed-length vector of zeroes.

LibraryTriageBody.description: Set the triage state of a library entry.

triage_state.description: Filter by triage state: inbox, later, archive.

LocatorSchemaFlat.description:
Schema-only flat representation of the LocatorSchema tagged union for OpenAPI code generators.
The real runtime type is `LocatorSchema` (internally tagged enum), but utoipa's `oneOf`
without a discriminator produces `Any` in Kotlin/TS generators. This flat struct captures
the union of all variant fields so code generators produce a concrete type.

MarkAllDeliveriesSeenBody.description: Mark all unseen deliveries seen, optionally scoped to one subscription.

MilaDocumentProvenanceResponse.description:
Composed document provenance (TASK-234 AC#6). Concretely typed (no `serde_json::Value`) so
generated clients get a real type. Distinguishes Library-backed documents from prepared
unsaved documents with durable capability rows.

setup_required.description: True when the instance has no users yet and is awaiting first-run setup.

signups_enabled.description:
Whether new account registration is currently permitted (config flag, or
always true during first-run setup when no users exist yet).

document_id.description:
The materialized/adopted document for the delivery. A readable-preparation render is
always queued; load the document and poll its readable asset for readiness.

ReadAheadBody.description:
Trigger read-ahead preparation when the user opens Feed, optionally scoped to one
subscription (which also marks that subscription active for this pass).

document_ids.description: Ids of the documents queued for preparation.

prepared.description: Number of documents materialized and queued for readable preparation.

ResolveChunkResponse.description:
Response for resolving a single chunk in a session. When the chunk has
audio ready, `audio_url` is populated with the document/session-scoped API
proxy path.

SaveFromDeliveryBody.description: Save a feed delivery into the Library.

SaveUrlBody.description: Save a URL/manual/API item into the Library.

item_type.description:
One of: article, book, email, pdf, tweet, video, podcast. Inferred from the URL when
omitted.

delivery_id.description:
Set for `feed_preview` results: the unprepared delivery; the client opens/prepares the
canonical reader keyed by this id (no document is materialized by searching).

source_entry_id.description: Set for `feed_preview` results: the source entry behind the delivery (provenance).

StepData.description:
Freeform step-completion payload. All fields are optional; each step
uses only the fields relevant to it.

VoicePersonaResponse.description:
Persona response — represents a voice persona owned by the user (or a
built-in persona shipped with the product).

pronunciation_prefs.description:
Opaque string->string map of pronunciation overrides (regex ->
replacement is the typical shape). Treated as an opaque bag at the
API layer.
